title: 第23章 生日宴第24章 既怕兄弟过得苦
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第23章生日宴（..）“什么周望，你不是说他不来了吗？”
于沛沛听见男友的惊呼，不由诧异的转过头来。
旁边几个同学也都看了过来，他们全都是一个班的，本来对于今天周望居然没有来就很奇怪，此时听见对方的名字自然都很关注。
“沛沛，你快看那是不是周望？”
因为隔的有点远，而且那个坐在车上的人无论是发型还是气质都和他认识的周望完全不一样，若不是他穿的那件T恤也很眼熟，李晟甚至有点不敢认。
于沛沛和几個同学都顺着李晟手指的方向看了过去，也看到了那辆黑色的埃尔法，但等他们看到的时候，车门已经关上，也看不见里面的人影了。
“哪呢哪呢？”
“周望没看到，倒是那个走进来的姐姐很漂亮啊！”
“这个姐姐长得很像某个明星哎，你们不觉得吗？”
“是有点像，就最近正红的那个花旦，不过她的气质很冷，两个人的风格不太一样……”
一旁的李晟有些无语，不是在说着周望吗，怎么聊着聊着这话题就歪了？
不过有一说一，那个小姐姐确实挺美的……从这点来说的话，李晟认为自己应该是看错了。
他和周望知根知底，那辆埃尔法就不可能和狗哥有什么关系，这个看起来很高冷的小姐姐就更不可能了。
“丁一发来消息了，包间在五楼，我们上去吧！”
这时，于沛沛看了一眼信息招呼众人道。
他们已经在大堂等了好一会儿，但刚刚丁一一直没有回消息，他们早就有点不耐烦了，闻言赶紧跟着于沛沛一起走向了电梯。
李晟也没有再纠结，只是还是掏出手机给周望发了条消息：
“周望，我刚刚看见你失散多年的兄弟了，只不过人家坐的是埃尔法，弟弟你得努力啊！
（狗头）”
……

另一边，姜沫稀里糊涂的就在迎宾的指引下坐进了行政楼层的专属电梯，等到了五楼，这里又有另外一个戴着耳麦的服务员已经在等候她了。
“您好，女士，请问您要去的是哪个包间？”
“……山河厅。”
姜沫意识到，她此时受到的待遇都是周望带来的。
不然哪怕是五星级酒店，也不可能从大门口开始就一直有专人在带路，更不可能让她乘坐VIP专用的电梯。
可周望又说他只是住在这家酒店，姜沫一时间也想不明白怎么回事，只是单纯的住宿的话，不可能有那么大的面子吧？
就这么想着心事，姜沫一路来到了山河厅，等推开了大门，一个内部隔成了两间的小宴会厅就展现在眼前，同时传来的，还有嘈杂的人声。
这么多人？
姜沫下意识蹙了蹙眉，她现在最讨厌的就是这种场合，但下一刻，一个带着些惊喜的清悦嗓音传了过来，又让她放缓了表情。
“姜师姐，你终于来啦！”
看着跑过来把自己一把抱住的女孩，姜沫难得的笑了笑。
“路上有点堵车，所以来晚了一些……伱今天很美。”
“是吗？”
听见平常很清冷的姜沫师姐这样夸赞自己，丁一露出了开心的笑容，松开姜沫之后还特意转了一圈，娇俏的脸颊上露出了一点小得意。
“我也这样觉得哎！”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Financial Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 23 Birthday Party (..) "What Zhou Wang, didn't you say he won't come?"
When Yu Peipei heard her boyfriend's exclamation, she couldn't help but turn her head in surprise.
Several classmates nearby also looked over. They were all in the same class. They were originally surprised that Zhou Wang didn't come today, but now they were naturally very concerned when they heard his name.
"Peipei, look quickly, is that Zhou Wang?"
Because they were a bit far apart, and the person sitting in the car was completely different from the Zhou Wang he knew in terms of hairstyle and temperament. If it weren't for the fact that the T-shirt he was wearing looked familiar, Li Sheng wouldn't even dare to recognize him.
Yu Peipei and several classmates looked in the direction of Li Sheng's finger and saw the black Alfa, but when they saw it, the door had been closed and no one could be seen inside.
"Where is it?"
"Zhou Wang didn't see it, but the sister who walked in was very beautiful!"
"This sister looks like a certain celebrity, don't you think?"
"It's a bit similar to the actress who's been popular recently, but her temperament is very cold, and their styles are quite different..."
Li Sheng on the side was a little speechless. Wasn't he talking about Zhou Wang? Why did the topic go wrong while chatting?
But there is one thing to say, that young lady is indeed quite beautiful... From this point of view, Li Sheng thought that he must have been wrong.
He and Zhou Wang knew very well that there was no way that Alfa had anything to do with Brother Dog, and it was even less possible for this cold-looking young lady.
"Ding Yi sent a message. The private room is on the fifth floor. Let's go up!"
At this time, Yu Peipei glanced at the message and greeted everyone.
They had been waiting in the lobby for a while, but Ding Yi had not responded to the message just now. They had already become a little impatient. After hearing this, they quickly followed Yu Peipei to the elevator.
Li Sheng didn't hesitate anymore, but took out his mobile phone and sent Zhou Wang a message:
"Zhou Wang, I just saw your long-lost brother, but he was sitting in the Alpha. Brother, you have to work hard!
(dog head)"
…
On the other side, Jiang Mo confusedly got into the exclusive elevator of the executive floor under the guidance of the greeter. When she reached the fifth floor, there was another waiter wearing a headset waiting for her.
"Hello, madam, which private room are you going to?"
"...Shanhe Hall."
Jiang Mo realized that the treatment she received at this time was all caused by Zhou Wang.
Otherwise, even if it is a five-star hotel, it would be impossible for someone to guide her from the gate, let alone let her take the VIP-only elevator.
But Zhou Wang also said that he was just staying in this hotel. Jiang Mo couldn't figure out what was going on for a while. If he was just staying, he couldn't have such a big reputation, right?
With this thought on his mind, Jiang Mo went all the way to the Shanhe Hall. When he opened the door, a small banquet hall divided into two rooms appeared in front of him. At the same time, there were noisy voices.
So many people?
Jiang Mo frowned subconsciously. She hated this kind of situation the most now, but the next moment, a pleasant and pleasant voice with some surprise came over, making her calm down again.
"Senior Sister Jiang, you are finally here!"
Looking at the girl who ran over and hugged him, Jiang Mo gave a rare smile.
"There was a bit of traffic jam on the road, so I came a little late... It's beautiful today."
"Really?"
Hearing the usually cold Senior Sister Jiang Mo praise him like this, Ding Yi showed a happy smile. After letting go of Jiang Mo, he deliberately turned around, with a little pride on his pretty cheeks.
"I think so too!"
